risks.rationale: agent.agent_run_runtime_manifests intentionally has RLS enabled with no client policy because authenticated and anonymous roles have no CRUD grants; adding a permissive policy only to silence the advisor would broaden access.
compensatingControls: authenticated and anon have no table CRUD grants
runtime manifest persistence is service-side privileged code only
any future authenticated grant requires project-scoped RLS plus adversarial tests
risks.closureCondition: Close only when the advisor condition can be removed without broadening client access, or replace the locked-table posture with an explicitly tested project-scoped RLS design.

risks.rationale: The four app_private membership helpers are intentional SECURITY DEFINER authorization helpers used by RLS and authorization predicates. They are authenticated-callable, derive identity from auth.uid(), use an empty search_path, and do not expose membership table contents.
compensatingControls: empty search_path with schema-qualified authoritative relations
member and non-member behavior is subject to live authorization validation
risks.closureCondition: Close if the helpers can move to an equally safe SECURITY INVOKER or non-exposed design without breaking recursive RLS authorization; otherwise renew only with fresh live positive and negative evidence.

risks.rationale: agent.resolve_runtime_interrupt is an authenticated SECURITY DEFINER RPC because it is the governed human approval/rejection boundary for a pending runtime interrupt.
compensatingControls: project-admin authority is evaluated before row locking
unknown and unauthorized interrupt identifiers share a generic fail-closed response
decision and action-payload hash are validated
timeout and cancellation automation remain service-role only
live hostile-user and authorized-user rollback tests leave zero residue
risks.closureCondition: Close if the RPC can be replaced by an equivalently safe invoker or non-exposed boundary; otherwise renew only with current advisor review and adversarial authorization evidence.

risks.rationale: Supabase leaked-password protection is not enabled on the current plan and must not be represented as remediated.
compensatingControls: upgrade decision required before higher-risk production use
risks.closureCondition: Enable leaked-password protection on a supported plan and re-run the live Supabase security advisor before claiming closure.
